question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
-- Final query: bowler with lowest bowling average
WITH runs_per_bowler AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_off_bat
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
extras_per_bowler AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(e.extra_runs) as extras
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
wickets_per_bowler AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT p.player_name, 
       r.runs_off_bat + COALESCE(e.extras, 0) as total_runs_conceded,
       w.wickets,
       1.0 * (r.runs_off_bat + COALESCE(e.extras, 0)) / w.wickets as bowling_average
FROM runs_per_bowler r
LEFT JOIN extras_per_bowler e ON r.bowler = e.bowler
JOIN wickets_per_bowler w ON r.bowler = w.bowler
JOIN player p ON r.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

FROM runs_per_bowler r
